A patent, which protects new inventions and processes

questions.subject: BUSINESS_ENTREPRENEURSHIP
questions.stem: Quillden develops a distinctive logo for its skin-care creams brand. Which form of intellectual property best protects that logo?

options.text: A copyright, which protects original creative works generally
options.misconception: Copyright does not primarily protect brand identifiers

options.text: A trade secret, which protects undisclosed confidential information
options.misconception: A public logo is not kept secret

options.text: A patent, which protects new inventions and processes
options.misconception: A logo is not an invention

options.text: A trademark, which protects distinctive marks identifying a source

questions.explanation: A trademark protects symbols, names, and logos that distinguish the source of goods. Patents cover inventions, copyrights cover creative expression, and trade secrets protect information kept confidential, so a visible brand mark fits a trademark.
questions.hint: Brand identifiers are protected by trademarks.
